en: Philippians 4

p.src: 1  Therefore, my brothers, beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, stand firm in the Lord in this way, my beloved.

en: Therefore, my brothers, beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, stand firm in the Lord in this way, my beloved.
u.src: 1  Therefore, my brothers, beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, stand firm in the Lord in this way, my beloved.

p.src: 2  I exhort Euodia, and I exhort Syntyche, to think the same way in the Lord.

en: I exhort Euodia, and I exhort Syntyche, to think the same way in the Lord.
u.src: 2  I exhort Euodia, and I exhort Syntyche, to think the same way in the Lord.

p.src: 3  Yes, I beg you also, true partner, help these women, for they labored with me in the Good News with Clement also, and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the book of life.

ja: の協力者であるあなたにもお
いします。この女性たちを
たちはクレメンスやほかの
たちとともに、福音のために
en: Yes, I beg you also, true partner, help these women, for they labored with me in the Good News with Clement also, and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the book of life.
u.src: 3  Yes, I beg you also, true partner, help these women, for they labored with me in the Good News with Clement also, and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the book of life.

p.src: 4  Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”

en: Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”
u.src: 4  Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”

p.src: 5  Let your gentleness be known to all men. The Lord is at hand.

ja: あなたがたの柔和さが、すべての
られるようにしなさい。
en: Let your gentleness be known to all men. The Lord is at hand.
u.src: 5  Let your gentleness be known to all men. The Lord is at hand.

p.src: 6  In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.

ja: いによって、あなたがたの
en: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.
u.src: 6  In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.

p.src: 7  And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.

ja: が、キリスト・イエスにあって、あなたがたの
en: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.
u.src: 7  And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.

p.src: 8  Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report: if there is any virtue and if there is anything worthy of praise, think about these things.

ja: の良いことは何であれ、また、
することがあれば、それらのことを
en: Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report: if there is any virtue and if there is anything worthy of praise, think about these things.
u.src: 8  Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report: if there is any virtue and if there is anything worthy of praise, think about these things.

p.src: 9  Do the things which you learned, received, heard, and saw in me, and the God of peace will be with you.

ja: があなたがたとともにいてくださいます。
en: Do the things which you learned, received, heard, and saw in me, and the God of peace will be with you.
u.src: 9  Do the things which you learned, received, heard, and saw in me, and the God of peace will be with you.

p.src: 10  But I rejoice in the Lord greatly that now at length you have revived your thought for me; in which you did indeed take thought, but you lacked opportunity.

ja: あなたがたがこのたび再び、私を気遣う
いを表してくれたことを、私は
びました。実際、あなたがたは気遣ってくれていましたが、それを表す
en: But I rejoice in the Lord greatly that now at length you have revived your thought for me; in which you did indeed take thought, but you lacked opportunity.
u.src: 10  But I rejoice in the Lord greatly that now at length you have revived your thought for me; in which you did indeed take thought, but you lacked opportunity.

p.src: 11  Not that I speak because of lack, for I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content in it.

ja: っているのではありません。どのような
en: Not that I speak because of lack, for I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content in it.
u.src: 11  Not that I speak because of lack, for I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content in it.

p.src: 12  I know how to be humbled, and I also know how to abound. In any and all circumstances I have learned the secret both to be filled and to be hungry, both to abound and to be in need.

ja: することにも、あらゆる
en: I know how to be humbled, and I also know how to abound. In any and all circumstances I have learned the secret both to be filled and to be hungry, both to abound and to be in need.
u.src: 12  I know how to be humbled, and I also know how to abound. In any and all circumstances I have learned the secret both to be filled and to be hungry, both to abound and to be in need.

p.src: 13  I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.

ja: くしてくださるキリストによって、私はどんなことでもできます。
en: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.
u.src: 13  I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.

p.src: 14  However you did well that you shared in my affliction.

ja: それでも、あなたがたは私の
にあずかってくれました。よくしてくれたのです。
en: However you did well that you shared in my affliction.
u.src: 14  However you did well that you shared in my affliction.

p.src: 15  You yourselves also know, you Philippians, that in the beginning of the Good News, when I departed from Macedonia, no assembly shared with me in the matter of giving and receiving but you only.

ja: たち、あなたがた自身も
めたころ、私がマケドニアを
けることについて私と分かち合った教会は、あなたがたのほかに一つもありませんでした。
en: You yourselves also know, you Philippians, that in the beginning of the Good News, when I departed from Macedonia, no assembly shared with me in the matter of giving and receiving but you only.
u.src: 15  You yourselves also know, you Philippians, that in the beginning of the Good News, when I departed from Macedonia, no assembly shared with me in the matter of giving and receiving but you only.

p.src: 16  For even in Thessalonica you sent once and again to my need.

ja: テサロニケにいたときでさえ、あなたがたは私に必要なものを、
en: For even in Thessalonica you sent once and again to my need.
u.src: 16  For even in Thessalonica you sent once and again to my need.

p.src: 17  Not that I seek for the gift, but I seek for the fruit that increases to your account.

ja: めているのではありません。あなたがたに帰せられる実りが増し加わることを
en: Not that I seek for the gift, but I seek for the fruit that increases to your account.
u.src: 17  Not that I seek for the gift, but I seek for the fruit that increases to your account.

p.src: 18  But I have all things and abound. I am filled, having received from Epaphroditus the things that came from you, a sweet-smelling fragrance, an acceptable and well-pleasing sacrifice to God.

ja: るほど持っています。エパフロディトから、あなたがたの
りています。それは芳しい
en: But I have all things and abound. I am filled, having received from Epaphroditus the things that came from you, a sweet-smelling fragrance, an acceptable and well-pleasing sacrifice to God.
u.src: 18  But I have all things and abound. I am filled, having received from Epaphroditus the things that came from you, a sweet-smelling fragrance, an acceptable and well-pleasing sacrifice to God.

p.src: 19  My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.

ja: は、キリスト・イエスにあって、栄光のうちにあるご
en: My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.
u.src: 19  My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.

p.src: 20  Now to our God and Father be the glory forever and ever! Amen.

ja: りなくありますように。アーメン。
en: Now to our God and Father be the glory forever and ever! Amen.
u.src: 20  Now to our God and Father be the glory forever and ever! Amen.

p.src: 21  Greet every saint in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me greet you.

ja: キリスト・イエスにある
一人ひとりによろしく
えてください。私とともにいる
たちが、あなたがたによろしくと
en: Greet every saint in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me greet you.
u.src: 21  Greet every saint in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me greet you.

p.src: 22  All the saints greet you, especially those who are of Caesar’s household.

ja: たち、特にカエサルの家に属する人たちが、あなたがたによろしくと
en: All the saints greet you, especially those who are of Caesar’s household.
u.src: 22  All the saints greet you, especially those who are of Caesar’s household.

p.src: 23  The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

ja: みが、あなたがたすべてとともにありますように。アーメン。
en: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
u.src: 23  The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
